remarks: Investor Alert! Welcome to 66 W Parade Ave, Buffalo, NY 14208! Excellent opportunity for investors seeking a multi-family investment property. The first floor features 3 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, a spacious living room, a large dining room, and a kitchen. The second floor offers 3 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, a spacious living room and dining room, a kitchen, and an additional bedroom. The property also includes a full attic and a full basement, providing additional storage space and potential for future improvements, subject to applicable approvals. Some renovation work is needed, offering investors the opportunity to make improvements and customize the property to suit their investment goals. Conveniently located within walking distance of Martin Luther King Jr. Park and the Buffalo Museum of Science, this property offers easy access to nearby recreational and cultural attractions. Whether you’re looking to expand your rental portfolio or explore your next investment project, this property offers plenty of possibilities. Don’t miss this opportunity to explore its potential!
